sophie_customer: Hey team — our trial account (acct_9b3f) made several streaming completions yesterday but the credits still show unchanged. Request IDs: r_20260316_01, r_20260316_02. Can you check?

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you paste one of the full request IDs + the exact timestamp you saw the successful stream finish? Also did you see any client disconnects?

sophie_customer: Sure. r_20260316_01 at 2026-03-16T18:12:03Z. Client reported HTTP/1.1 200 and got the final 'data: [DONE]' chunk. Screenshot attached (sent DM). No explicit disconnect on client side.

maria_support: Thanks — looking at the server logs for acct_9b3f and r_20260316_01 now. Quick question: were you using the streaming SDK or raw HTTP?

sophie_customer: streaming SDK (js) v0.12.1. We do automatic retry on 5xx with idempotency-key set.

maria_support: Hmm. I can see an entry for r_20260316_01 in the proxy logs but no corresponding usage debit in the billing events table. The runtime did stream tokens back to the client. Attaching short log excerpt: 

```
2026-03-16T18:12:03Z INFO stream_open req=r_20260316_01 client=10.2.5.8
2026-03-16T18:12:07Z INFO stream_chunk req=r_20260316_01 tok=125
2026-03-16T18:12:10Z INFO stream_chunk req=r_20260316_01 tok=98
2026-03-16T18:12:11Z WARN connection_reset req=r_20260316_01 peer_reset
2026-03-16T18:12:11Z INFO stream_close req=r_20260316_01 reason=client_closed
```

maria_support: That last "client_closed" looks like the client closed before the final usage event was emitted to billing. Escalating to infra/engineering.

raj_engineer: Looping in infra — possibly related to a known gap: if a streaming connection closes right after the final token is sent, the billing emitter sometimes misses the final "usage_complete" event when retries are involved. We pushed a partial fix (idempotent event dedupe) but there's a race where connection_reset -> no final write -> no debit.

raj_engineer: Repro steps we used locally:
1) start a streaming request with a long tail
2) simulate client-side TCP FIN immediately after last chunk
3) observe proxy logs show stream_close but billing_event not created

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: demo-123" \
  --no-buffer \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-3.5-stream
```

raj_engineer: Workaround: disable client auto-retry for streaming calls or ensure client sends an explicit terminal event (SDK patch planned to emit a final ack). Also we can retroactively emit missing usage events for impacted requests if we have the stream logs.

maria_support: From logs we have token counts for both r_20260316_01 and r_20260316_02. I'll request a manual credit reconciliation for acct_9b3f and ask billing to emit the missing debits.

billing_bot: Automated ticket created: BILL-2026-3284. Assigned to billing-team. Please include the log excerpts and request IDs. Estimated SLA: 48h for reconciliation.

henry_pm: We should credit the customer's trial immediately to avoid friction. Propose granting 1,000 trial tokens to acct_9b3f and follow up with a fix release. Raj — can you target a patch for the SDK/server within next week?

raj_engineer: Yes — targeting a server-side emitter retry + SDK final-ack in the 7-day window. I'll add a postmortem after the patch. Commit reference will be shared in this thread.

maria_support: Sophie — we've opened the billing ticket and issued a temporary 1,000-token credit to your trial (visible immediately). Billing will attempt to replay usage events for r_20260316_01/02. I'll update here when reconciliation completes.

sophie_customer: Thanks, Maria — appreciate the quick help. Can you ping me once it's fully reconciled? Also please share the SDK patch ETA so my team can plan.

maria_support: Will do — ETA from eng is ~7 days for the fix. Billing SLA 48h for the manual replay. Keeping this thread open until fully resolved. :thumbsup:
